actual_interface_review.control: Lite 0 (control, address width 5): AP_CTRL 0x00, command 0x10. Read command zero after cold reset and read back every written BEGIN=0/RUN=1. Lite 1 (control_r, width 7) pointer low/high pairs: 10/14, 1c/20, 28/2c, 34/38, 40/44, 4c/50, 58/5c. Read all halves zero, then program and read back all nonzero 64-bit bases.
actual_interface_review.axi: Seven AXI interfaces: 32-bit data, 64-bit addresses, 1-bit IDs, all 45 pins connected. The unchanged accepted endpoint is wrapped by five one-entry, lossless VALID-hold adapters per port, with fixed 0..3-cycle exposure delays and selected 16-cycle holds.
actual_interface_review.read_ranges: Descriptor first 640 B; IO 32 KiB; AUX first 128 B; qkv0 Q offsets 0..255, K 0x400000..0x403fff, V 0x800000..0x803fff; qkv1 none; ATT_OUT first 256 B; observed none.
actual_interface_review.write_ranges: Only ATT_OUT first 256 B and observed first 1024 B. Endpoint rejects unmapped or 4 KiB crossing bursts. Both monitors check full addresses, ID/LAST/STRB and independent response debt; W before AW is supported.
actual_interface_review.precision_correction: The real top reads ATT_OUT to export AV into observed. The erroneous write-only testbench restriction was corrected before EDA. The actual top overrides ATT_OUT CH0_NUM_WRITE_OUTSTANDING to 1; adapter defaults are not treated as the instantiated configuration.

four_calls: BEGIN request 301/generation 1: ticket 1, pair epochs 1/FILL, 2 claims, zero tasks and coverage.
Pending BEGIN rejects with d2000004 and retains the pair.
RUN original receipt executes LOAD_KV, QK, Softmax and AV: phase 13, 4 tasks, 6 claims, coverage 3072, READY pair, partial ATT_OUT E_BUFFER 04080009 and successful cleanup.
Replay RUN rejects with d2010005: phase 3, four tasks retained, no numeric traffic.
functional_contract.metadata: Check all 30 written status words, observed[0..15] and [224..237], exactly for every command. Other words are the 192 numerical values or explicit deadbeef/A5 guards. Scan every mapped input page after each command, all 256 KiB ATT_OUT, and require replay identity.
functional_contract.traffic: RUN qkv0 AR/R/RLAST count 8256 and 33024 bus bytes; qkv1 has no traffic. ATT_OUT AR/R count 64 and 256 read bytes; AW/W/B count 64 and 256 bus/useful write bytes. Other calls have no QKV or ATT_OUT traffic. Both monitors and adapter accepted/delivered counts match with no pending debt.
functional_contract.hold: Select an actual terminal QKV R beat on the negative edge and record its address, burst beat, LAST, index and consumed wait >=16. Final ATT_OUT B must be index 64/address base+252 with wait >=16. Latch the consumed wait before later transfers reset the adapter counter.
functional_contract.done: Sample actual DUT ap_done at the positive edge and check first assertion on the next negative edge, after same-edge response retirement. No extra drain wait. Check CSR done/idle separately. No reset between the four commands; host page replacement requires drained interfaces.

numeric_review: The offline checker reads four sealed observed dumps, two ATT_OUT dumps and frozen QKV/gold hashes. Require 64 exact QK words, 64 finite probabilities within the original binary32 1e-4 + 1e-4*abs(gold) tolerance, and 64 exact AV words independently reduced from actual probabilities and frozen V with separate binary32 multiply/add rounding. Also apply the original end-to-end AV tolerance. ATT_OUT first 256 B equals observed AV; all other bytes remain A5. No oracle fixture is regenerated. Python binary64 exactly represents each finite binary32 product before explicit binary32 packing; every add is separately rounded and no FMA is used.

finite_components.basis: 8256*27=222912 QKV read component +44736 QK +2294 softmax +45056 AV =314998; 2*8256*5=82560 serialized AR/R adapter allowance; 100000 other-interface allowance. RUN finite control includes 16 reserved/24 digest/4 build-tag/48 metadata checks, 48*64 mask-row visits, at most 48 cover calls and 6144 check/mark row visits, 48 publish all_rows calls *64 bit tests=3072 and 128 covered-row marks, <=3072 report popcount shifts, two owner snapshots, 64 score +64 probability +64 AV observation writes, 64 ATT_OUT reads, 32 cleanup owner visits and 30 status resets. BEGIN parses a 128B header, 4*16 tag bytes, 5 directories, 64 token and 16 marker entries; two QKV claims scan <=32 owners each and clear 6144 plane plus 4096 rope bitmap words and 2*2*64 owner-row words. Remaining watchdog capacity covers these loops plus generated FSM/control and arbitration; it is not a proven latency bound. Every 100000 cycles prints state/phase hint, seven-port counts and actual XSim RSS.

budget_review.interpretation: The 314998-cycle arithmetic/read-call component, 82560-cycle serialized AR/R adapter allowance, 100000-cycle other-interface allowance, and enumerated finite owner/parser/coverage/control work support a prior 2M RUN stop limit. This is not a proved total latency. BEGIN/rejections have 200k limits, the suite 2.7M. Every 100k clocks logs progress and actual XSim RSS; the guard samples at 0.2 s.
budget_review.wall_feasibility: Prior ACT suite clocks divided by guard wall time gave 1684..3767 clocks/s including startup; 2.7M/1684 is about 1604 s. Attention uses different RTL and pages, so its rate remains unknown. The 3600 s proposal is a finite first measurement budget, not a completion guarantee. Preserve a slow or failed first run without automatic budget growth.
budget_review.static_feasibility: The packet binds 216 Verilog modules and six FP wrappers. Prior Q8 static build with 230 modules/seven wrappers took 204.7 s and about 4.0 GiB owned RSS. The 300 s/16 GiB proposal bounds the first static build; equal cost is not assumed.

build_and_runtime: Exact commands and fresh paths are frozen in the packet. Bind 35 absolute DAT links at build/runtime, ten absolute input links, and an absolute runtime xsim.dir link to the compiled snapshot using default lookup. Only four exact XSim runtime files may change and must be archived; all other changes, additions or deletions fail. The existing read-only phase_rss.so is hash-bound and loaded through xelab --sv_lib/--sv_root; no helper compilation is included.
limits: Cold B1/S64 Decision layer 0, head 0/query 0 only. Head 15, changed QKV and coverage faults remain later runtime gates.
Actual Q8/RoPE producer integration remains unproven; host image verification and a digest receipt do not establish hardware cryptographic authentication.
Warm reset of pending/session/request/claim metadata remains unaccepted; immutable v5 is cold-only.
HLS 5.390 ns exceeds the effective 4.867 ns target. The 6.666 ns simulation clock proves no Fmax, OOC, platform, board or 50 ms result.
The first materializer script was not pre-hash-frozen or archived. Its failure and guard are retained; corrected v2 bytes are independently accepted.
reviewer_actions: Read actual source, HLS, generated RTL and logs; independently hash, serialize and compare; write reviewer records only. No compiler, simulator, materializer or numerical oracle was executed.
